abstract: Does the behaviour of mutual fund managers chasing hot trends and frequently rebalancing across industries introduce vulnerability into the corporate stocks? To address this issue, we create a novel stock-level potential vulnerability measure based on the cross-industry rebalancing magnitude of mutual funds holding the stock. We find that stocks bearing higher vulnerability subsequently experience higher crash risk. Fund style drift and fund illiquidity cannot account for our findings. Further analysis suggests that this positive effect is primarily realized through channels such as delaying the integration of negative corporate information into prices and boosting price bubbles. KEYWORDS: Frequent cross-industry portfolio rebalancing crash risk stock price bubbles fund style drift fund illiquidity JEL CLASSIFICATION: G00 G01 G23
abstract_zh: 共同基金管理者追逐热门趋势并频繁跨行业调整投资组合的行为，是否会增加企业股票的脆弱性？为探究这一问题，我们基于持有某只股票的共同基金跨行业调整幅度，构建了一种全新的股票层面潜在脆弱性度量指标。研究发现，脆弱性较高的股票随后会面临更高的崩盘风险。基金风格漂移与基金流动性不足无法解释这一结果。进一步分析表明，这种正向效应主要通过延迟负面企业信息融入价格以及助推价格泡沫等渠道实现。关键词：频繁跨行业投资组合调整 崩盘风险 股票价格泡沫 基金风格漂移 基金流动性不足 JEL分类：G00 G01 G23
title: Does frequent cross-industry portfolio rebalancing by mutual funds introduce vulnerability into stocks?
title_zh: 共同基金频繁的跨行业投资组合再平衡是否会给股票带来脆弱性？
